approved.en: Ukraine launched a drone strike that killed a worker at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant and hit a missile-fuel plant in St Petersburg, while Russia continued missile and drone attacks on Ukrainian power facilities and the Northern Bridge. Russia began rationing petrol after Ukrainian strikes damaged its second-largest refinery in Saratov, prompting Rosneft to cap sales, and a Russian FPV drone wounded three energy workers in Sumy Oblast. Trilateral peace talks involving the United States, Russia and Ukraine are underway in Abu Dhabi. A senior US soldier was arrested in Britain on suspicion of spying for Russia. 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Gunfire struck tents at the Rafah displacement site in Gaza as aid teams prepared for winter storms, while Israeli fire in the Gaza Strip killed seven people, including a 13-year-old boy. Israeli forces beat a Palestinian university president during an IDF raid in the West Bank and shot dead a 14-year-old boy there, and movement restrictions continue to hamper health actors such as MSF. The Israeli prime minister's office allowed winter supplies to enter Gaza but said Hamas must disarm before reconstruction can proceed. Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton visited Gaza aid facilities on the Egyptian side of the Rafah crossing. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israelske styrker slo en palestinsk universitetspresident under et IDF-angrep på Vestbredden og skjøt en 14‑årig gutt der til døde, og bevegelsesrestriksjoner fortsetter å hindre helseaktører som MSF. Israels statsministerkontor tillot vinterforsyninger å komme inn i Gaza, men sa at Hamas må avvæpnes før gjenoppbygging kan fortsette. Formel‑1‑mesteren Lewis Hamilton besøkte hjelpesentre i Gaza på den egyptiske siden av Rafah-overgangen. FN rapporterte 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Israeli forces continued cross-border activity, returning an Israeli man who entered Lebanon and expanding a 90 km road network and new bases while conducting airstrikes on Qantara and shelling that wounded a Lebanese footballer and led to the detention of a 65‑year-old retired engineer. Hezbollah persisted in firing artillery at Israeli positions and began cash payments to war victims and displaced families. France opened a probe into alleged Israeli war crimes and protests against Israeli attacks occurred in Sweden. The conflict caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces maintain a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have seized the al-Jawf mountain range, sharpening front-line fighting. Houthi rockets damaged the Saudi Aramco tower in Riyadh and a Saudi strike near Sanaa killed 22 civilians, mostly women and children; a Houthi-claimed airstrike near the capital also killed 22 people. The coalition intercepted a cruise missile, a long-range anti-tank guided missile and downed a ballistic missile aimed at Medina, and Saudi Arabia shot down missiles fired at Riyadh after a Houthi attack on the East-West pipeline. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Houthi-raketter skadet Saudi Aramco-tårnet i Riyadh, og et saudisk angrep nær Sanaa drepte 22 sivile, for det meste kvinner og barn; et houthi-påstått luftangrep nær hovedstaden drepte også 22 personer. Koalisjonen avskjærte en cruise-missil, en langdistanse-antitank-styrt missil og skjøt ned en ballistisk missil rettet mot Medina, og Saudi-Arabia skjøt ned missiler som ble avfyrt mot Riyadh etter et houthi-angrep på Øst-Vest-røret. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Iran-linked drones struck the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan, halting production and cutting about 2.8 GW of power, and Iraqi forces responded with airstrikes on three suspected militants and a tunnel in Kirkuk's Zghaitun Valley. Iraqi officials identified the launch site of the Khor Mor attack and said militia leaders are seeking Chinese and Russian air defenses, prompting deployment of air defenses to fifty locations. Baghdad reopened the Sheeb border crossing with Iran after a three-week closure and agreed to withdraw Turkish forces from the Zilkan base by the end of 2026. Former Iraqi MP Ahmed al-Alwani was found dead in a Beirut apartment. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024.

approved.en: The Sudanese army has taken Bakori and Sali and pushed back attacks in the Blue Nile while advancing in West Kordofan, as the Rapid Support Forces continue drone strikes that have killed civilians in Blue Nile and White Nile states and caused a two-week power blackout that raised prices. A senior RSF commander defected to the army after 13 years, and Pakistan signed a 1.5 billion-dollar security cooperation deal with Sudan. Drones now account for two thirds of child casualties in the conflict. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En senior RSF-kommandør deserterte til hæren etter 13 år, og Pakistan signerte en sikkerhetssamarbeidsavtale på 1.5 milliarder dollar med Sudan. Droner står nå for to tredjedeler av barnas dødsfall i konflikten. 4 680 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Government forces and opposition fighters continue to clash, most recently in Akobo, while governors in Jonglei and Aweil East call for peace ahead of the first elections. Ugandan truck drivers were ambushed and killed, with their bodies released by South Sudanese authorities. The Mayom County commissioner and his family were assassinated, and a soldier and a civilian were killed in an attack in Kapoeta North. Communal fighting in Tonj East left 11 dead before calm returned, and churches reported worship disruptions due to violence. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ugandiske lastebilsjåfører ble overfalt og drept, og deres lik ble frigitt av myndighetene i Sør-Sudan. Kommissæren i Mayom fylke og hans familie ble myrdet, og en soldat og en sivil ble drept i et angrep i Kapoeta Nord. Kommunalt oppgjør i Tonj East førte til 11 døde før roen kom tilbake, og kirker rapporterte om forstyrrelser i gudstjenester på grunn av vold. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian drones are now operating over Sudan while RSF drones launch from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets, prompting reciprocal diplomatic expulsions and consular closures. An RPG strike near a school in Moyale killed dozens of Ethiopian Orthodox believers and a Kenyan, sparking increased police deployment and security talks, and attacks on Orthodox Christians continue in Arsi, Benishangul Gumuz and the north, with blasts heard in Addis Ababa. Seed insecurity threatens Tigray farmers and a psychosocial and spiritual care pilot is being tested. The war caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Et RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale drepte dusinvis av etiopiske ortodokse troende og en kenyaner, noe som har ført til økt polititilstedeværelse og sikkerhetsdialog, og angrep på ortodokse kristne fortsetter i Arsi, Benishangul Gumuz og i nord, med eksplosjoner hørt i Addis Ababa. Sikkerhetsproblemer for frø truer bønder i Tigray, og et pilotprosjekt for psykososial og åndelig omsorg blir testet. Krigen forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Militant groups and bandits continue to attack civilians in Nigeria, killing a pastor, a pregnant woman, schoolchildren and a family of twelve, while troops repelled a terrorist assault and rescued three kidnapping victims. In Mali, Africa Corps drones are conducting lethal strikes and rival terror groups are devastating the Sahel, and Malian forces recaptured Kidal with Russian electronic-warfare vehicles operating there. Russian influence expanded as Russia helped foil a coup in Niger, prompting EU concern over Algerian and Russian troop deployments in Niger, and a €46 million West African intelligence and cyber contract was awarded to Mer Group. Burkina Faso, after aligning with Russia, partnered with another Western state on its 36th reunification anniversary. The conflict still generates high fatalities, with 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Mali utfører Africa Corps-droner dødelige angrep, og rivaliserende terrorgrupper ødelegger Sahel, mens maliske styrker gjenerobret Kidal med russiske elektronkrig-kjøretøy som opererer der. Russisk innflytelse økte da Russland hjalp til med å avverge et kupp i Niger, noe som førte til EU-bekymring over algeriske og russiske troppeutplasseringer i Niger, og en kontrakt på 46 millioner euro for vestafrikansk etterretning og cyber ble tildelt Mer Group. Burkina Faso, etter å ha alliert seg med Russland, inngikk partnerskap med en annen vestlig stat på sin 36. gjenforeningsdag. Konflikten genererer fortsatt høye dødstall, med 4 159 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

A reported bandit leader, Kachalla Bello, was killed in Katsina, and gunmen have kidnapped and later released a mother and three sons after a ransom demand. The conflict recorded 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: The military court in the Democratic Republic of Congo has sentenced 66 soldiers to death for cowardice and mutiny after they fled fighting FRN rebels, intensifying pressure on the FARDC as the FRN advances on multiple fronts. ISIS-linked militants killed 33 people, prompting patients to flee a hospital and raising concerns about Ebola spread in the region. Allied Democratic Forces militants attacked Cantine in North Kivu, further destabilising the area. The Africa CDC called for a humanitarian corridor to protect Ebola response efforts. Battle-related deaths totaled 1,158 in 2024, according to UCDP.

ISIS-tilknyttede militante drepte 33 personer, noe som fikk pasienter til å flykte fra et sykehus og vekket bekymring for spredning av ebola i regionen.
